response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development experience with relevant geospatial projects (e.g., GISCollective). However, his background lacks direct commercial experience with C++ or Rust in routing/tiling pipelines, and his recent roles emphasize TypeScript/Node.js over low-latency systems or distributed data processing.
strengths: Extensive geospatial experience via GISCollective and Green Map, including open-source contributions and event-driven architectures
Proven track record in building scalable systems (e.g., Optilyz’s Direct Mail platform, Sociomantic’s low-latency micro-services)
Strong problem-solving and experimentation mindset, evidenced by workshops and talks on functional programming/testing
concerns: Primary expertise in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, with limited recent C++/Rust experience (critical for the role)
Geospatial work focuses on web/mobile platforms rather than high-performance routing data pipelines or real-time traffic integration
No explicit experience with distributed systems concepts like fault tolerance or consistency at scale in commercial routing environments
